fixtures_from: the diagnostic artifact's loader-tests/, generated from runtime build 96ee4ef2d025
experiment: M1.2: every malformed-runtime fixture on real hardware. Each copied to the card as /KUI/runtime.kui, booted without holding B, then the log saved with Y.

conclusions: All five fixtures are rejected on hardware, each for its own reason: a bad header, a bad format version, a truncated or oversized image, and a checksum mismatch.

The checksum case is the only one that starts loading (it prints the runtime's build ID and size) because its header is valid; the check fails after the payload is read. The others are refused at the header, before any payload is read.
Every one fell back to the built-in CD diagnostics, and each log was saved to the card with Y, so the controller and SD writes work in the fallback.
With the missing-file and good-runtime-restoration checks already reported, M1.2 is complete on hardware.

hardware.console: NTSC video (from every log); motherboard reported as 'V1A', most likely the VA1 revision; region not stated
hardware.card: SanDisk 128 GB microSD, Endurance line (reported as 'ultra endurance'); exFAT, 249,997,312 sectors, 128 KiB clusters
hardware.cold_boots: dozens, with no controller problems (user report); the plan asked for five
